plan.title: 3-Day Historical Jaipur Itinerary
plan.summary: Explore Jaipur's iconic forts, palaces, and astronomical marvels over three days, blending guided tours, local cuisine, and cultural immersion.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.description: The Pink City of Rajasthan, famed for its royal heritage, vibrant markets, and UNESCO World Heritage sites.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: A majestic hilltop fort with intricate frescoes and mirror work; take an elephant ride or jeep up to the entrance.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: A blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture housing museums, courtyards, and the Chandra Mahal.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed astronomical instrument complex; great for photography and learning about ancient science.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: The 'Palace of Winds' with its honeycomb façade; best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort
attractions.description: Offers panoramic sunset views over the city; ideal for an evening stroll and light snacks.

attractions.name: Albert Hall Museum
attractions.description: Rajasthan's oldest museum showcasing royal artifacts, textiles, and sculptures.

hotels.name: Zostel Jaipur
hotels.description: Clean dorms and private rooms in the heart of the old city, with a rooftop lounge and communal kitchen.

hotels.name: Hotel Pearl Palace
hotels.description: Heritage-style boutique hotel near City Palace, offering comfortable rooms and a rooftop pool.

hotels.name: Rambagh Palace
hotels.description: Former royal residence turned 5‑star hotel, featuring opulent suites, spa, and fine‑dining restaurants.

daily_schedule.title: Amber Fort & Jaipur Introduction
daily_schedule.morning: Pick up from hotel; drive to Amber Fort. Guided tour of the fort, Sheesh Mahal, and Ganesh Pol.
daily_schedule.afternoon: Lunch at 1135 AD (fort restaurant). Return to city; visit City Palace and its museum.
daily_schedule.evening: Stroll through Bapu Bazaar, dinner at Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB) for Rajasthani thali.

daily_schedule.title: Astronomy & Architectural Gems
daily_schedule.morning: Visit Jantar Mantar; explore the massive sundials and instruments.
daily_schedule.afternoon: Walk to Hawa Mahal; photo stop. Lunch at Rawat Misthan Bhandar (RMB). Visit Albert Hall Museum.
daily_schedule.evening: Enjoy a cultural dinner with folk dance at Chokhi Dhani (optional) or relax at hotel.

daily_schedule.title: Fort Views & Departure
daily_schedule.morning: Leisurely breakfast; head to Nahargarh Fort for a mid‑morning hike and city vistas.
daily_schedule.afternoon: Lunch at Padao (restaurant on the fort). Return to hotel for checkout; free time for souvenir shopping in Johari Bazaar.
daily_schedule.evening: Transfer to Jaipur airport or railway station.

travel_tips: Hire a local driver or use the RTDC guided bus (₹600 ≈ $8) for hassle‑free sightseeing.
Carry cash in INR for small vendors; most attractions accept cards but not all street stalls.
Dress modestly for temple visits and carry a scarf for sun protection.
Start early at popular sites like Amber Fort to beat the crowds and heat.
